### Until the Son of God Appeared
Author: Jonathan Parnell
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/until-the-son-of-god-appeared
Passage: Genesis 5:29
Points:
- Lamech named his son Noah hoping he would bring relief from humanity's painful labor under the curse.
- Noah’s birth embodied the ancient expectation that a promised descendant of Eve would reverse the curse.
- While Noah walked with God and preserved human life through the ark, he ultimately fell into sin.
- Jesus came as the true and blameless Son who defeated the curse not by fleeing judgment, but by enduring it.
- Advent invites believers to rejoice that Christ has definitively arrived to rescue and redeem fallen creation.
